svg.aria-label: Pair counts for two staggered agent swarms, source rows by target columns. Every cell with a count lies above the diagonal, so no text ever flowed from a later-started agent to an earlier one. 40 edges across both runs: 38 direct, 2 two-hop, 0 backward, 0 unexplained.
svg.text: Who leaked to whom, in two live swarms
Pair counts at containment ≥ 0.35. Rows are the source run, columns the target. Agents start 45 seconds apart.
direct — the target read a file named after the source
two-hop — credited to the first author, not the intermediary
40 edges over two runs: 38 direct, 2 two-hop, 0 backward, 0 unexplained.
Every edge checked against the target's own commands by code/verify_edges.py.
